text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Is there anything troubling you?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If you ever have any worries, like 
communicating with your trainee Umamusume, 
please feel free to reach out to me 
anytime♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I like to think I understand the 
feelings of the Umamusume at least a 
little.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"...The irresistible urge to start 
sprinting. The desperate longing to aim 
for greater heights..."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
So, as fellow comrades supporting the 
Umamusume together, please rely on me to 
your heart's content from now on♪
